before.name: measured_import_kwh
before.description: Measured imported energy, kWh. Only VALID, non-estimated readings; dates use Asia/Singapore.
before.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN meter_readings.quality_status = 'VALID' AND meter_readings.is_estimated = 'false' THEN meter_readings.import_kwh ELSE 0 END)
before.grain: One aggregate over the selected source records
before.time_rule: Reporting timezone: Asia/Singapore; no date filter
before.reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(import_kwh) AS measured_import_kwh
FROM meter_readings
WHERE quality_status = 'VALID'
  AND is_estimated = 'false'
example_questions: What is the measured electricity consumption?
assumptions: The metric only includes readings with a quality status of 'VALID' and where 'is_estimated' is false.
